Description

About Ajaia

Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We build software that helps organizations use AI in real work. We are growing our engineering team to build education technology products.

The role

You will build features for our education products. You will work with the Lead Developer and the product team. You will write clean code, fix bugs, and ship work on a regular schedule.

What you'll do

Build and improve features for learning platforms
Write front-end and back-end code
Connect our products to LMS tools and school systems
Write tests and fix bugs
Help add AI features to the product
Use AI coding tools in your daily work to write, test, and review code faster
Share progress and raise problems early
Requirements
1-3 years of software development
Experience working on EdTech or learning products
Good skills in React or Next.js, and in Node.js or Python
Comfortable with APIs, databases, and Git
Basic knowledge of accessibility and student data privacy
Hands-on experience using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) in a real project
Regular use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) and the judgment to check their output
Good written and spoken communication: clear updates, and questions asked early
Willing to learn fast and take ownership

Nice to have

Experience with LTI, SCORM, or xAPI
Experience with prompt design, RAG, or AI agents
Experience with video, quizzes, or assessment tools
Benefits
Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus
Remote work with earned flexibility.
Work on AI products with real clients
Learn from an experienced Lead Developer on a growing EdTech product line
Apply for this job
